scope: Preserve three existing legacy writer output fixtures around the unchanged numeric runner. The runner owns all compiler/runtime processes; this controller owns the runner process tree.

limitations: PID membership and CPU counters are sampled separately.
PID changes or counter resets interrupt CPU delta continuity.
Activity is sampled evidence, not a root-cause diagnosis.
Log size changes do not measure content or useful progress.
Unreported child PIDs and CPU are outside the observed scope.
CPU scope changes or counter resets break delta continuity.
